title: Water
gist_ar: نشرة أخبار: اللي غضّب الناس مش الحادثة، لكن إنهم محدش بلّغهم.

before_listening.en: A news bulletin and a live report. Listen for what has angered residents MOST — it is not the accident.
before_listening.ar: نشرة أخبار وتقرير مباشر. ركّز على إيه اللي غضّب السكان أكتر حاجة — ومش الحادثة.

segments.speaker: Anchor
segments.text: Good evening. Water pressure has been restored to most of the eastern districts tonight, twelve hours after a main was ruptured during construction work. Around forty thousand homes were affected. The company says the pipe had been marked on the plans, and that the contractor has been suspended while the incident is investigated. Our correspondent is in Zeitoun.

segments.speaker: Correspondent
segments.text: The pipe was cut at about six this morning. Within an hour the street had been closed, and by nine the water had been shut off across four districts. What has angered people here is not the accident, because accidents happen. It is that they were not told. The company's message was sent to registered mobile numbers only, and in this district most accounts were opened before that system existed. So thousands of people had their supply cut with no warning at all. Several residents told me they had their tanks filled by neighbours who happened to have heard.

segments.speaker: Correspondent
segments.text: The section is being replaced tonight rather than patched, which is why it has taken longer. It should be finished by morning. Schools in the four districts have been told to open as normal, and the two hospitals were never affected; they have their own tanks. The wider question, how many other pipes are marked on plans that contractors are not required to check, has not been answered, and it was not asked at this afternoon's press conference either.

gist_question.q: What has angered residents most, according to the report?
gist_question.q_ar: حسب التقرير، إيه اللي غضّب السكان أكتر؟
options: That they were not warned, because the alert system missed older accounts
That the pipe is being replaced instead of patched

questions.q: Why did many residents never receive the message?
questions.q_ar: ليه كتير من السكان موصلتهمش الرسالة؟
options: Their accounts were opened before the mobile alert system existed
It was sent to the wrong district

questions.q: Why is the repair taking longer than expected?
options: The section is being replaced rather than patched
The contractor was suspended and had to be replaced mid-repair
The street had to be closed first

questions.q: Which question was not asked at the press conference?
questions.q_ar: أنهي سؤال محدش سألهوش في المؤتمر الصحفي؟
options: When exactly the water supply would be fully restored to homes
How many other pipes contractors are not required to check
